risks.note: More than 70% of revenue from operations came from the top five customers during the last 3 fiscal years; Customer 1 alone was 31.75% of total sales in FY 2026 (34.63% in FY 2025, 41.94% in FY 2024) and the top ten customers were 88.64% / 90.63% / 96.00%. Any cancellation, loss or reduction of orders could materially affect revenue and business operations.
risks.risk: Reliance on a limited number of key customers and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)

risks.note: The Company generally does not enter into long-term purchase agreements with these customers, or where entered they set out only general terms and do not stipulate firm volume or sales commitments. Purchase orders / delivery schedules may be cancelled unilaterally with or without cause, or there may be delays in lifting goods, adversely impacting revenue and results of operations.
risks.risk: No firm volume commitments — sales run on purchase orders

risks.note: Before being appointed as a supplier to OEMs or their vendors in the automotive and electric vehicle segments, the Company must pass a qualification and assessment process including facility evaluations, process audits and testing of sample components; components also undergo customer-specific inspection and validation before purchase orders are issued, and facilities are subject to periodic audits by customers and certification authorities.

Unit III at Gat No. 382, 383, 386, 387, 312 Village, Tal.-Khed, Dist.-Pune is still to be established and depends on the net proceeds of the Issue, with Rs. 10633.59 lakhs earmarked; the Issue Price, Gross Proceeds and Net Proceeds all remain undetermined ([●]) in the Red Herring Prospectus.
risks.risk: Execution and funding risk on the proposed Unit III

risks.note: Unit IV is being set up only to carry out sample development and submission activities for magnesium precision components until customer and OEM approvals are obtained — commercial production is contingent on approvals not yet received.

Maharashtra accounted for 60.64% of revenue as at March 31, 2026 (65.50% in FY 2025, 68.44% in FY 2024); exports were only Rs. 248.2 lakhs / 0.84% in FY 2026 versus Rs. 716.69 lakhs / 3.23% in FY 2025, indicating a volatile international revenue stream.
risks.risk: Geographic concentration of revenue in Maharashtra and volatile exports

risks.note: Installed melting capacity rose to 13800 MT in 2025-26 from 9300 MT and 7800 MT in the prior two years, with utilization at 80% (melting) and 84% (casting & finishing); utilization had previously dipped to 72% and 70% in 2024-25, and final orders received may fluctuate based on demand at that time.
risks.risk: Capacity utilization gap after a step-up in installed capacity

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- More than 70% of revenue from operations came from the top five customers during the last 3 fiscal years; Customer 1 alone was 31.75% of total sales in FY 2026 (34.63% in FY 2025, 41.94% in FY 2024) and the top ten customers were 88.64% / 90.63% / 96.00%. Any cancellation, loss or reduction of orders could materially affect revenue and business operations.
- The Company generally does not enter into long-term purchase agreements with these customers, or where entered they set out only general terms and do not stipulate firm volume or sales commitments. Purchase orders / delivery schedules may be cancelled unilaterally with or without cause, or there may be delays in lifting goods, adversely impacting revenue and results of operations.
- Before being appointed as a supplier to OEMs or their vendors in the automotive and electric vehicle segments, the Company must pass a qualification and assessment process including facility evaluations, process audits and testing of sample components; components also undergo customer-specific inspection and validation before purchase orders are issued, and facilities are subject to periodic audits by customers and certification authorities.
- Unit III at Gat No. 382, 383, 386, 387, 312 Village, Tal.-Khed, Dist.-Pune is still to be established and depends on the net proceeds of the Issue, with Rs. 10633.59 lakhs earmarked; the Issue Price, Gross Proceeds and Net Proceeds all remain undetermined ([●]) in the Red Herring Prospectus.
- Unit IV is being set up only to carry out sample development and submission activities for magnesium precision components until customer and OEM approvals are obtained — commercial production is contingent on approvals not yet received.
- Maharashtra accounted for 60.64% of revenue as at March 31, 2026 (65.50% in FY 2025, 68.44% in FY 2024); exports were only Rs. 248.2 lakhs / 0.84% in FY 2026 versus Rs. 716.69 lakhs / 3.23% in FY 2025, indicating a volatile international revenue stream.
- Installed melting capacity rose to 13800 MT in 2025-26 from 9300 MT and 7800 MT in the prior two years, with utilization at 80% (melting) and 84% (casting & finishing); utilization had previously dipped to 72% and 70% in 2024-25, and final orders received may fluctuate based on demand at that time.
- The Company states it has recently entered the aerospace segment and obtained vendor approval from a customer for the supply of its products; no aerospace revenue appears in the sector revenue tables for 23-24, 24-25 or 25-26.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up manufacturing Unit III at Gat No. 382/383/386/387/312, Tal. Khed, Pune from IPO proceeds to produce components similar to those at existing facilities**
- **Set up Unit IV at Village Mahalunge, Khed for sample development and submission of magnesium precision components until customer and OEM approvals are obtained**
- **Deploy Rs. 3,000 lakhs of IPO net proceeds to meet incremental working capital requirements**
- **Commercialize the recently entered aerospace segment where vendor approval from a customer has been obtained**
- **Continue diversifying customer base and end-use industries beyond automotive - EV, agriculture, defence, energy, healthcare and engineering goods**
- **Set up the proposed solar power projects on farmland at Village Bhaganurwadi, Tal. Mukhed, Nanded (two sites, with additional land held for future use)**
- **Set up a new manufacturing facility (Unit III) at Gat No. 382, 383, 386, 387, 312 Village, Tal.-Khed, Dist.-Pune, funded from the net proceeds of the Issue, to produce components similar to those made at the existing facilities.**
- **Set up Unit IV at Gat No. 201/1, Village - Mahalunge, Tal.-Khed, Dist.-Pune to carry out sample development and submission activities for magnesium precision components until customer and OEM approvals are obtained.**
- **Apply net proceeds of the Issue to meet working capital requirements.**
- **Undertake a fresh Issue of up to 53,10,000 Equity Shares and list on the SME Platform of BSE Limited, applying proceeds to Unit III capex, working capital and general corporate purposes.**
- **Develop proposed solar projects on farmland at Village Bhaganurwadi, Tal- Mukhed, Dist. Nanded, Maharashtra (Gat No. 122, 128 and Gat No. 125), with Gat No. 120 held for future use.**
- **Build out the recently entered aerospace segment, having obtained vendor approval from a customer for the supply of products, as part of diversifying the customer base and end-use industries.**
